description: This file defines serialization and deserialization utilities for various JavaScript objects, including typed arrays, errors, dates, URLs, regexes, and complex object graphs, used within the Playwright project for cross-context data handling.

methods.name: isRegExp
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a RegExp.

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a Date.

methods.name: isURL
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a URL.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is an Error.

methods.name: isTypedArray
methods.description: Checks if an object is a specific typed array.

methods.name: typedArrayToBase64
methods.description: Converts a typed array to a base64 string.

methods.name: base64ToTypedArray
methods.description: Converts a base64 string back to a typed array.

methods.name: parseEvaluationResultValue
methods.description: Deserializes a SerializedValue into a JavaScript value, resolving references and special objects.

methods.name: serializeAsCallArgument
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value into a SerializedValue suitable for remote calls.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value with special handling for global objects and complex types.

methods.name: innerSerialize
methods.description: Performs the core serialization logic, handling various data types and object graphs.
